summary: Frontend-only validation of the redesigned Equity Curve on the Dashboard. All acceptance criteria for the redesign passed: single green line, gradient fill, right-side currency Y-axis, bottom date labels, working hover tooltip with dashed crosshair, no red / no 'Minimum' series, live legend showing $117,205 = 112,480 startBalance + 4,725 realized P&L. Range filters (All / 7D / 30D / 90D / 1Y) update the chart smoothly without page reloads and never mutate the Total Balance card. Empty state renders correctly when there are no trades ('No equity data yet' + 'Log your first trade to start building your equity curve.'). Demo data restored via POST /api/trades/demo after empty-state test.

minor.issue: Endpoint also deletes accounts (server.py line 218 `await db.accounts.delete_many(...)`). The review spec / user contract describes this endpoint as 'clear the journal / so there are no trades', so also wiping accounts is surprising. During the empty-state test the starting balance dropped to $0 (0 accounts) instead of remaining at $112,480. Empty-state chart still rendered correctly, but the starting balance figure shown is $0 rather than the desired $112,480. Consider splitting the two concerns or renaming the endpoint (e.g. DELETE /api/data).

acceptance_test_results.single_green_line_no_red: PASS - only 2 SVG paths with stroke #34d399 (line + area); no red strokes anywhere
acceptance_test_results.no_Minimum_series_or_legend: PASS - 'Minimum' text absent from the entire page
acceptance_test_results.right_side_y_axis_currency: PASS - $110,000 -> $118,000 rendered on the right side
acceptance_test_results.data_consistency: PASS - equity endpoint = $117,205 = startingBalance(112,480) + realizedPnl(4,725) = Total Balance card
acceptance_test_results.curve_starts_at_start_balance_not_zero: PASS - anchor point equal to starting balance placed one day before first trade, chart Y range 110k-118k (never touches 0)
acceptance_test_results.hover_tooltip: PASS - hover produced tooltip 'Aug 9, 2026 / $115,280' with dashed vertical crosshair line
acceptance_test_results.tooltip_no_forbidden_fields: PASS - no Minimum/Risk/Reward text in tooltip
acceptance_test_results.range_filters_All_7D_30D_90D_1Y: PASS - all five buttons switch chart smoothly, no full page reload, Total Balance card unchanged at $117,205
acceptance_test_results.session_filter_analytics_only: PASS - Session dropdown ('All Sessions' custom dropdown) does not mutate Total Balance card
acceptance_test_results.empty_state: PASS - 'No equity data yet' + 'Log your first trade to start building your equity curve.' rendered; starting balance shown as $0 because DELETE /api/trades also cleared accounts (see backend minor issue)

action_items: (Optional / minor) Decide whether DELETE /api/trades should really also delete accounts. If yes, keep as-is but note it in docs; if no, split so /api/trades only clears trades and starting balance ($112,480) survives the empty-state view.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive elements (range buttons, chart tab buttons, filter dropdowns, EquityChart SVG) have NO data-testid attributes. Testing had to fall back to role/text selectors. Recommend adding data-testid to at least: range buttons (range-all, range-7d ...), chart tab buttons (tab-equity, tab-winrate, tab-daily), EquityChart wrapper (equity-chart), and Total Balance value (total-balance-value).
EquityChart.jsx (211 lines) is well-scoped and self-contained; nice use of ResizeObserver, Catmull-Rom smoothing and niceScale. No issues found.
calc.js equityCurve() correctly anchors first point at starting balance dated firstTradeDate - 1 day, then cumulates chronologically. Matches spec.
server.py DELETE /api/trades semantically overloaded (also clears accounts) - see backend minor issue.
test_credentials: admin@tradesentinel.com / Sentinel@2025 (from review request; file /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty)

The only open item is a minor backend semantic question about DELETE /api/trades also clearing accounts. Frontend has no data-testid on the new chart or filter buttons - if next iteration adds testids, tests can be tightened.
